title: She's the He!
overview: Before graduation, Ethan and Alex pose as trans women in a last ditch effort to quell gay rumors. It's all a joke until Ethan realizes: she really is trans. The two must reckon with their changing friendship, coming out, and coming-of-age.

title: CAMP
overview: Emily is the cause of two tragedies early in her life; her dad suggests she go to a Camp for troubled youth to ease her guilt. When Emily arrives, she is taken in by the other counsellors; they accept her as she is and wrap her in a veil of peace & forgiveness. Emily stands at the forefront of a new kind of life, but there’s a voice out there in the woods she can’t ignore, telling Emily to go home.

title: Bouchra
overview: Wrestling with writer’s block for her first film, Bouchra, a queer Moroccan jackal living in NYC, starts having difficult yet overdue phone calls with her mother in Casablanca that begin influencing the project. Balancing the precarity of working as an artist, the rift in her cultural identity and an array of romantic interests, Bouchra’s emotional reckoning becomes her path to expression.

title: Kick Ons
overview: When every attempt to leave a looping backyard party fails, two twenty-somethings must confront the fact that their lives- and friendship- are moving on.

title: Homage
overview: A reformed street figure risks everything when he tries to help an old friend fresh out of prison, only to discover that some debts don't disappear; they come back to collect.

title: Autumn Leaves
overview: On the edge of herself, Ellie retreats into memory, not to escape, but to find a reason to stay. A quiet, unflinching portrait of a young woman fighting to remember who she was before the world got loud.

title: Lavender
overview: When lesbian writer Audrey runs into her ex-boyfriend, Julian, she must confront her bisexual panic or risk losing her sense of identity.

title: Agatha
overview: A murdered victim of abuse returns to take revenge on humanity, drawn toward a young man whose troubled psyche may draw more similarites to the dead than he first thought.

title: Góðufellarnir
overview: In a world where gangster rule, we follow Henry Hill through his rise and fall...

title: Welcome to Borovia
overview: Harry Enfield heads a brilliant cast in this quirky political comedy where plots, counterplots and seduction flourish in faraway Borovia.

title: The Barrel
overview: A young prankster wakes trapped in a metal barrel in an abandoned workshop. He must find a way out and learn how and why he got there. Estranged from his devout father, he can only rely on him, shackled to a pole nearby, for guidance.

title: Final Orders
overview: Set in France in 1916, three British soldier's are facing the firing squad for cowardness. As they await their fate they have to overcome their own differences and class as in the eyes of death all men are equal.

title: Maxim Commodity Ballet
overview: A kaleidoscopic exploration of found objects that express deeper human emotion.

title: Exchange
overview: A paralysed teenage boy, isolated on a private hospital ward. His life flashes before, last moments of life, with a vivid encounter with death. Is the accounted recollection forged or an authentic perspective ?

title: Faculty of Philology
overview: A student film that is a parody of popular para-documentaries broadcast on Polish television. Agnieszka realizes she's failing her film analysis class. To earn money for conditional pass, she commits immoral acts.

title: FASITO
overview: Experimental short film that follows the journey of some friends through the landscapes of Moreno.

title: Double Kill
overview: Twin assassins take on a night of violent contracts until betrayal turns their mission into a fight for survival, forcing sister against sister in a relentless clash of blood, loyalty, and revenge.

title: Christine Bermas: All The Way
overview: Get to know the woman behind the daring roles as Christine Bermas opens up beyond the camera. From her dating style to behind-the-scenes stories and personal experiences in her most talked about films, this special reveals a more honest and intimate side of the actress.

title: Are We Human Yet?
overview: When Logan gets pulled into an AI’s mind, he must avoid being hunted by the android to find a way of escape before he will lose his humanity forever.

title: Sundown Syndrome
overview: A homeless eats a strange biscuit and begins to hallucinate; everything around him becomes an evil space.

title: Slow & Stupendous
overview: Two friends go on an adventure to find a missing film in the Slow & Stupendous series.

title: PULSE
overview: A man isolated from society appears to have nothing to show for his life, yet in his solitude, he has quietly taught himself to see and hear the world with a depth and beauty that most people are too distracted to ever find.

title: Love, Ngo
overview: “Love, Ngo” follows Ngongo, a hardworking young man who volunteers at a cleft lip and palate foundation while helping at his mother’s burger stand. The film explores his struggles with love, family and self-acceptance after falling for a woman whose family disapproves of his condition and social status.

title: De Gaulle: Résistance
overview: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.

title: Hungry
overview: A group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose after becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands.

title: THE HUM
overview: During his class, Leo, who struggles with ADHD, fights to write a single word while the sensory overload of the room pushes him to his breaking point.

title: Earth, Wind & Fire (To Be Celestial vs. That's the Weight of the World)
overview: Examines the legacy, cultural impact, and body of work of American R&B/funk/jazz/soul/disco band Earth, Wind & Fire, and will feature exclusive access to the band’s archives of visual, audio, and written material, as well as the support of the estate of Maurice White and the band.

title: ARE YOU TELLING ME THAT YOU KNOW WHAT TO DO BECAUSE YOU GET NOTES FROM THE FUTURE TELLING YOU SO?
overview: After finding a note in his locker, a student discovers that he is receiving messages from his future self. As the instructions become increasingly specific, he begins to follow that path that seems to have been laid out for him.

title: Dogwood
overview: A grad student, home for the week and bouncing back from depression, reencounters an old "friend".

title: Graveyard Shift
overview: A lone office worker is stuck in a perpetual work loop. Once they become aware of that fact they start noticing the flaws in the environment; it causes their mental state to unravel.

title: Barako
overview: In his most daring VMX appearance yet, sought-after star Nico Loco explores manhood through a bold, sexy showcase of male-to-male films on VMX.

title: Test
overview: Eddie dreams of becoming a bodybuilding champion and escaping rural Ohio. Determined to prove himself, he begins training under a renowned coach and dedicates his life to the demanding discipline of the sport. His ambitions, however, create tension at home—particularly with his deeply religious mother, who disapproves of the path he has chosen and the lifestyle surrounding the bodybuilding world. As he pushes his body and mind to the limit in pursuit of success, he must navigate family conflict, personal sacrifice, and the pressure to live up to expectations while chasing his dream.

title: The Nest
overview: Wake up, get ready, a quick breakfast to the sound of his favourite jazz – and it is time to rush off to work, just like every day.

title: Barbara Forever
overview: An archive-driven exploration of the life, work, and legacy of iconic, pioneering lesbian filmmaker Barbara Hammer.

title: The Blood Countess
overview: The Blood Countess and her maid embark on a quest for the red elixir of life and a book that threatens the vampire realm. Hot on their heels are a police inspector, two vampirologists, a vegetarian nephew and his therapist.

title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
overview: Gibney’s “Knife” will explore Rushdie’s recovery “in the broadest sense”, according to a press release. Through Rushdie’s wife Rachel Eliza Griffiths’ personal footage, which has never been seen by the public, the doctor will follow the writer during not only his physical recovery but also the recovery of his spirit and hope for the future. In "Knife", Rushdie writes, “It’s a story in which hatred—the knife as a metaphor of hate—is answered and finally overcome by love.”

title: Heysel 85
overview: When 39 people are killed prior to the European Cup at the Brussels Heysel stadium in 1985, the mayor's daughter and an Italian journalist are torn between their professional assignments, family, and human nature.

title: Scary Movie
overview: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

title: Masters of the Universe
overview: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.

title: Kata Hati
overview: When celebrity actress Ayra Natasha's glamorous life unravels in one humiliating night - a red carpet disaster, a cheating boyfriend, and a viral disappearance, she finds herself in the back seat of a stranger's car, ugly-crying into a box of tissues. Her unlikely rescuer is Imran Firdaus, an e-hailing driver with nowhere particular to be and no reason to care… except that he does.  What begins as a forced arrangement - Imran hired as Ayra's personal driver to contain a tabloid storm slowly becomes the one real thing in both their lives. But Ayra belongs to a carefully constructed world of sponsors, film contracts, and a power couple narrative that her manager-sister Maya cannot afford to let fall apart.  Kata Hati is a Malay-language romantic comedy about the words we perform for the world, and the ones we only dare say to the ones we love.

title: Left Behind
overview: A deaf man searches for understanding.

title: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai
overview: When Jass leaves his marriage over conflicting priorities, a new romance abroad is upended by shocking revelations, forcing him to confront love, loyalty, and the true meaning of commitment.

title: All That We Never Were
overview: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grapples with grief, haunting nightmares and a fractured sense of self.

title: DAY THREE
overview: Nathan, 23, descends into a night of intimacy, euphoria and disorientation. He jolts awake at the care of paternal figure, Sam, who helps him survive through the aftermath of a chillout. Cracks begin to show as Nathan’s smile is quieter now – aware that survival isn’t the same as safety, and that next time, the night might not let them go so easily.

title: Maa Behen
overview: In this dark comedy, a woman calls her estranged daughters in the middle of the night with chilling news — there's a dead body in her kitchen.

title: Petey & I
overview: Albert Minogue is a grieving father looking for spiritual reconciliation, instead he discovers a baby alien called Petey who he believes to be a reincarnation of his deceased son.

title: Wind
overview: In a time after devastating wars, plagues, and natural disasters, the social order has collapsed, and new moral systems, beliefs, and forms of survival emerge. The story follows Ivan Morozov, who leaves his wife Katya to search for necessities, and meets Sergei Volkov, a mysterious companion. Together, they travel through haunting landscapes filled with forgotten villages, strange rituals, and mythological echoes, culminating in a profound and painful choice.

title: Kucing Hitam
overview: Natalie's life turns into a terrifying nightmare after her youngest daughter brings home a mysterious black cat with the power to resurrect the dead. Family members who died in a tragic incident return to life as cold strangers. Natalie is trapped inside the house with a substitute entity controlled by the cat. She soon discovers the harsh reality that her real family is gone and can only watch her from the window as unreachable shadows.

title: The Murder of Rachel Nickell
overview: A young mother is killed in broad daylight on London's Wimbledon Common — in front of her toddler. This documentary examines the yearslong murder case.

title: Filterkoffie
overview: Nervous job applicant Martijn is offered a magical coffee by HR Manager Rianne, making it impossible for him to lie and causing the interview to take some surprising turns.

title: Космическая Машка
overview: Masha spent her entire 11 years of life with her cosmonaut father at the spaceport. She knows how to fly a plane, a boat, and take responsibility for herself, but she doesn't know how her peers live. To make friends and get used to life on Earth, she goes to a regular school in St. Petersburg, where her incredible adventures begin.

title: Sooriya Sulanga
overview: Against a backdrop of deep-rooted conflict and intense romance, ordinary individuals are pushed to their absolute limits when a complex web of relationships begins to unravel. To survive a turbulent storm of high-stakes adversity, they must navigate unexpected choices to protect what matters most.

title: The Barbershop
overview: As a young foster child searches for belonging in a black barbershop in Copenhagen, he finds himself struggling to be black enough in a place that should feel like home.

title: Дени и Мэни. В кино!
overview: When Deni, a Labrador, lands a major advertising contract and moves in with his agent, Andrey, he and his cat friend, Manny, who are used to being together, find themselves separated for the first time. Immersed in the dazzling world of show business, Deni gradually realizes that no amount of success can replace family, and that sincerity is more valuable than any contract. Meanwhile, Andrey is going through a crisis in his relationship with his fiancée, and it is Deni who helps him rediscover his faith in love.

title: Mil pedazos
overview: Miguel (55), Isabel (45), and Emilia (9) go on vacation with their dog, Eve. Suddenly, an accident in the middle of the desert leaves the mother seriously injured. Miguel, trying to save Emilia, embarks on a personal journey with his daughter to find answers about what happened. Three months later, Isabel awakens from a coma and begins a personal, loving, and intuitive quest to rebuild her family.

title: Poldi
overview: Footballer, entrepreneur, fan favorite and true community hero — Lukas Podolski reflects on his journey and what comes next in this intimate documentary.

title: The Portrait of Anxiety
overview: Best friends Keng and New embark on a quest to find hornbills. Despite enduring a long and arduous journey, they fail to see even one. What they do find instead is something far more unsettling—something truly chilling.

title: Dacha
overview: To Be Added soon

title: Animol
overview: Behind the walls of a young offender institution, Troy is thrust into a brutal world of gangs, loyalty and violence from the moment he arrives. When an unspoken bond develops with a fellow inmate, it becomes a dangerous vulnerability for them.

title: The Arab
overview: Haroun is an old bachelor who has lived in Oran for several years. A retired civil servant, he leads a reclusive life until the day he meets Kamel in a bar—a journalist to whom he tells an incredible story dating back to 1942. He claims to be the brother of ‘the Arab’ killed in a story told in one of the most famous novels of the 20th century, ‘The Stranger’ by Albert Camus. An Arab with an erased name: Moussa. Through anger, assertions, details, and confidences, Haroun finally convinces the journalist to listen to his story. His confession is a cry of freedom and distress—but above all, a cry of revolt: against an abusive mother, against a country that failed to achieve true independence, against a book, and against a famous French writer.

title: The Loneliest Man in Town
overview: Blues musician Al Cook lives in an apartment filled with memories. Outside, the world carries on without him. But when his home is slated for demolition, out of the ruins of his existence, a long-forgotten dream suddenly resurfaces.

title: Mollywood Times
overview: Vineeth Madhavan tries hard to become Malayalam cinema's greatest horror filmmaker, but will the toxic industry affect his dream?

title: Office Romance
overview: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees. When a new sexy lawyer begins working for her, that policy becomes very tested.

title: Signal One
overview: A computer scientist is invited by a tech billionaire to join his private facility on a Caribbean island to investigate extraterrestrial matter on Earth. When they make contact beyond our world, chaos erupts as we’re left to wonder: do they come in peace?

title: The Marked Woman
overview: When a woman is found in a shipping container with no memory of who she is, two detectives race to figure out her identity — and who wants her dead.

title: Parimala and Co
overview: A dark comedy centered around a chaotic family whose tangled relationships and unpredictable situations lead to emotionally charged and absurd moments, blending humor with underlying tension and drama.

title: Carolina Caroline
overview: A young woman, desperate to leave her small town, runs away with a charming con man, embarking on a crime and passion-filled journey through the Southeast to find her estranged mother.

title: Heated Pingpong
overview: Two guys end up playing ping pong and tension between the two forms

title: Savage House
overview: Against the backdrop of 18th century England, a massive pox outbreak, and Jacobite uprising – Sir Chauncey Savage and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. It's not without a tinge of irony that their family name is the Savages, for this is a Savage House indeed, filled with duels, decadence, and bloodshed.

title: The Passenger
overview: Hassan, a Somali-American airport shuttle driver in Minneapolis, is struggling to make ends meet. When Lloyd, a stranded twenty-something at the airport, offers to pay Hassan to take him overland to Chicago, it seems worth the risk. But as the realization grows that his passenger is not what he seems, Hassan finds himself trapped in a terrifying ride that he can’t escape, knowing that saving himself might put countless others in danger.

title: Dark West
overview: In a city consumed by violence, a cowboy walks through dark corridors in search of his missing partner. Between torture, revenge, and supernatural forces, something far greater seems to be watching him from the shadows.

title: Mango Pachcha
overview: Set in Mysuru, a crime drama unfolds across a decade (2001-2011), following a chain of events that builds tension over time. The city's setting plays a key role in reflecting different phases across the years.

title: The Rapture
overview: With the world set to end in two days, cousins Roo and Joo are unexpectedly reunited when Roo slips into a church to confess their sins, hoping to make peace before it's too late. Reminiscing on a lesson their koro taught them both growing up,“when the rapture happens you gotta go home”, for Roo, that means it's time to go home. But for Joo, home is a little bit more complicated.

title: Be with You
overview: A high school dropout and delinquent, Jie, falls in love with a quiet, speech-impaired high school girl, Guang, leading to a story of mutual growth and healing.

title: Bandar
overview: TV star Samar's life spirals when his ex Gayatri accuses him of rape after he blocks contact with her. Despite his new relationship with Khushi, he faces arrest and encounters a corrupt justice system.

title: March On
overview: A British Falklands Conflict veteran struggles to reintegrate into civilian life as a “welcome home” party exposes the hidden costs of war, forcing him and his wife to confront the trauma that continues to remain

title: Confessions II – The Film
overview: Follows a chaotic night out involving ambushing, worshipping, and pursuit that ultimately leads back to the dance floor.

title: Her Husband's Double Life
overview: Carrie's world is shattered when her husband is found critically injured in a car crash with another woman by his side--a woman who also claims to be his wife. Carrie discovers that someone will stop at nothing to erase her from the picture.

title: Turncoat
overview: A psychotic mastermind holds a group of interconnected strangers captive in a manipulative game with deadly consequences. Young and old, sinners and saints — everyone's guilty of something, but no one wants to pay the price.

title: Jean-Michel
overview: Follows Basquiat’s early life as the child of middle-class Haitian and Puerto Rican parents in Brooklyn, through his adventures in the punk subculture and up to his breakout as a major American artist. All the while, special attention is paid to Basquiat’s mental and emotional state, with interviews from former friends and colleagues to supplement his sisters’ impressions.

title: Passion
overview: John's life was always centered around his girlfriend, he did everything for her. When she dumped him, he was lost, he had a hole in his heart to fill. Will he find a passion to drive forward his life? Or will he let the emptiness consume him?

title: Fallen Angels
overview: Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.

title: Fujiko
overview: Subjected to harsh treatment by her husband Jiro’s family, Fujiko is devastated when Mari is kidnapped by Jiro’s relatives. With the help of her own mother, Chiyo, Fujiko regains her child. Against the advice and judgment of those around her, she chooses to raise Mari as a single mother.

title: Blue
overview: A 16-year-old boy spends a quiet day alone at a remote beach when a mysterious girl in a white dress approaches him, leading to a brief, intimate conversation about life, death, and reality.

title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
overview: Small-town Kansas hairdresser Gail Daughtry's fiancé uses his 'celebrity sex pass' on Jennifer Aniston, prompting Gail to travel to LA with her friend Otto to find her own pass, Jon Hamm, to even the score.

title: Late Fame
overview: Legendary New York poet Ed Saxberger's forgotten works captivate an eccentric group of young creatives, reigniting his artistic passion. Their intrigue intertwines with the bewitching presence of actress Gloria.

title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
overview: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

title: Summer House
overview: Selin travels back in time at a summer house and finds herself in her mother's youth, changing her family's fate and rebuilding her own life.

title: Ember
overview: An elderly couple is trapped in their village near Kyiv as it falls under Russian occupation. When a fire destroys their home, they are forced to seek refuge with neighbors and find a way out.

title: Detective Chen 2
overview: In 1930s Shanghai, a wrongly accused hero escapes death row and unravels a deadly conspiracy, battling enemies and uncovering a foreign plot that threatens his nation.

title: Paper Roses
overview: A blind date gone wrong. Or gone right? In Paper Roses, two individuals are set up on a blind date. Unknowing of what has yet to come, they hit things off quite well.

title: Sarsaparilla
overview: A lawman's relentless pursuit of his criminal adversary takes an unexpected turn when their showdown reveals a shared passion for country dance, transforming bitter enemies into unlikely allies on the dance floor.

title: BLOODSUCKER
overview: In her room, Katie talks to her therapist, Dr. Klein about her feud with Vicky Treehorn at school when her intentions turn sour and her victim mentality after calling her boyfriend might not be what it seems.

title: Human Theories
overview: Through forty interconnected vignettes, Human Theories is a comedic kaleidoscope exploring how people try, and often fail, to connect with one another in this weird world. Filmed over a year on location in New York City with a diverse ensemble cast of over 50 actors and non-actors, the film is an experimental love letter to the awkward struggle of modern city living.

title: The Heist
overview: Three teenage boys feel like robbing a house so they do, to lackluster results

title: Memory Lapse
overview: Sterling must relive the traumatic event of his sister's murder with the help of his therapist, through a device that allows them to enter his mind. By repeatedly traversing his memories, Sterling discovers the shocking truth.

title: Emergence
overview: From turbulence to stillness, light and matter pass through a succession of transformations. Amid shifting particles and luminous forms, chaos gradually gives way to revelation.

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
overview: When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda's army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

title: Forbidden Treasure
overview: In this Cliff Hanger short, treasure hunters finally discover the lost treasure of Amon Gu'ul but are soon divided by their own desires...

title: The Aura
overview: Claudia is an unlucky and fatalistic young woman. During an esoteric event in a bookstore, a disturbing apparition in an aura photo will turn her day and her friend Antonia’s upside down.

title: Never Fade
overview: Never Fade is a multi-dimensional creative project led by Thai actress Yoko Apasra Lertprasert, best known for her role in the Girls' Love (GL) series Blank. It serves as a personal brand and production house launched after her departure from NineStar Studios. The film is expected to explore emotional themes of resilience.

title: Labrador — Autopsy of Silence
overview: A cargo ship embarks on its final voyage of the year to resupply Inuit communities in the far north of Canada. During a storm off the coast of Labrador, the ship’s cook is found murdered in his cabin. With no way to identify the culprit among the twenty crew members, suspicion falls on Alupa, an Inuit mechanic and close friend of the victim.  Unfolding in reverse, from the investigation back to the night of the storm and the murder, the film transcends the boundaries of a traditional whodunit to probe deeper questions of race, class, and sexual desire.

title: No Survivors
overview: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, it follows a young man seeking revenge against the "White Tiger" bandits who destroyed his family.

title: Breeder
overview: A poodle breeder obsessed with genetic perfection offers an MIT dropout a bizarre proposition — she wants to breed him with her daughter.

title: Ponderosa
overview: When the buffet where Zeke's mom works closes down, he's forced to entertain the wild advances of a rich regular who is weirdly and vehemently obsessed with becoming his father.

title: Morte Cucina
overview: Sao, a talented cook, accidentally meets the man who took advantage of her in the past. She sets her revenge plan in motion using her cooking skill to achieve a rather unexpected result.

title: Queen at Sea
overview: As advanced dementia erodes an older woman’s ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interests, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection and autonomy.

title: I See Buildings Fall Like Lightning
overview: Childhood friends Patrick, Shiv, Rian, Oli, and Conor played together, skipped school together, and dreamt of the lives they would have one day. Now they’re thirty, and the future they imagined is slipping quietly out of reach.

title: The Youngins
overview: He is from Torre del Bierzo, an industrial mining town, where the name El Chispas inherits from, working in the family workshop.  She is a city girl who avoids the summers in his village, Sueros de Cepeda. Floating on his skates.  In a hot summer of the 90s they bathe together in the Villameca swamp. Everything changes when they discover the open secret under its waters.

title: Mon Taxi
overview: For years, calling her father was the daily ritual for Moroccan filmmaker Meriem Sakrouhi. When he passed, her urge to stay connected remained. One day, she decides to call him.

title: Detached
overview: Flor and his best friend Otis have always done everything together, but when a conversation reveals that their bond means different things to each of them, Flor is forced to confront a friendship he thought was unbreakable.

title: Away with Words
overview: In this silent romantic comedy-drama, a reality-challenged title writer must navigate the perils and possibilities of two worlds: the one in his head, and the one in which he has a chance at real love.

title: Caity
overview: Along with her newly sober father Paul, 16-year-old Caity prepares for the new Halloween season of their family-owned haunted house. When she recognizes signs of a relapse from Paul, she tries to cover them up but struggles to manage as she tests her own relationship to substances and an attraction to new employee Hannah.

title: The Prick
overview: After a devastating breakup, Hsing becomes emotionally numb, feeling unable to move on. To end his agony, Hsing decides to set out from southern Taiwan to Taipei to demand an apology from his unfaithful ex-boyfriend. But in the bitterly cold northern city, tangled desires bloom like a thorned flower—hurting him in return. While his ex finally offers him an olive branch by expressing remorse with kisses, Hsing just snaps. In that moment, apology, forgiveness, and revenge collide, leading to an irreversible act…

title: Everything That Remained of Sophia (And What Did Not)
overview: A poem by Sophia Ron brought to life. Silhouettes, shapes, caresses; death. Even irony and a strong youth alienation plague the images. But what will the kids do about it?

title: Free Fall – Who You Are
overview: Years after his life was turned upside down by a secret love affair with fellow police officer Kay, Marc is still caught between two worlds – the life he built and the truth he can no longer deny. Free Fall – Who You Are is a recut and reimagined version of the 2013 film Freier Fall, expanding the story beyond coming out into the question of what happens when an honest life truly begins. The first chapter of the Free Fall Trilogy.

title: NJPW Best of the Super Junior 33 - Day 14 (Final)
overview: The fourteenth and final night of Best of the Super Junior 33 took place on June 7, 2026 at Ota City General Gymnasium in Tokyo, Japan and was headlined by the final match to crown the tournament winner.

title: The Galoshes of Fortune
overview: A pair of magical pink shoes gives a homeless woman the fame and luxury she always wanted. However, she quickly discovers that her dream life is just an illusion.

title: Finnegan's Foursome
overview: Two middle aged brothers and their respective sons travel to Ireland to play the Finnegan Family's annual golf outing, where they distribute the ashes of the family patriarch

title: Flies
overview: Olga lives a strictly regulated life without attachments in a vast apartment block. When out of financial necessity she rents a room in her apartment to a man who also sneaks-in his nine-year-old son, an unlikely bond forms. Her carefully controlled world begins to shift, and their lives become intertwined against her will.

title: Mama
overview: After many years working far from home, Mila is forced to temporarily leave her seaside mansion—and her secret romance—to return to her family in a remote Polish village. But the long-awaited reunion is far from what she imagined.  As tensions surface, Mila struggles to repair what was lost, confronting the cost of her choices and the woman she has become.

title: Everytime
overview: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio take a trip to Tenerife  for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun,  past and present quietly start to overlap.

title: We Are All Strangers
overview: A life-altering event forces 21-year-old Junyang and his girlfriend to face reality. At the same time, while Junyang’s father is struggling to hold their modest life together, a woman enters his life and both generations are forced to redefine their family.

title: Filipiñana
overview: Isabel feels strangely drawn to Dr. Palanca, the president of the country club where she works. However, after piecing together a violent picture of what lies beneath the club’s pristine surface, she realizes that what began as an innocent infatuation is actually rooted in a sinister shared history.

title: Gentle Monster
overview: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

title: Deep sea exploration : the last frontiers on Earth
overview: In the deep ocean, where darkness reigns, scientists uncover a hidden world that sustains life on Earth. From extraordinary creatures to invisible microbial processes, the abysses play a crucial role in regulating the climate and ocean balance. But as the race for deep-sea minerals intensifies, this fragile ecosystem is under threat. A breathtaking journey into the largest, and least known, environment on our planet.

title: OutRunners
overview: On a dystopian future Earth, Cali and Xen, a pair of heroes from opposite ends of the galaxy, must overcome their differences in order to outrun scoundrels and bounty hunters in order to save their colony’s food supply.

title: Why I'm Quitting Music
overview: Forrest opens up about a difficult decision as he begins to question his future in music. Taking place before the events of the Thank You I Guess music video, this chapter explores a turning point in his journey while continuing the story of Indie Movie Sound Track.

title: That Friend
overview: Paul, “That Friend” who turns one drink into a full-blown bender, crashes his best friend Henry’s romantic weekend with his new girlfriend Penny, only to unleash chaos when his drug-laced cigarettes disappear into a stranger's hands.

title: She Didn't See Me
overview: In a chance encounter at a 711, Audric has a conversation with his crush, Clara, as he deliberates confessing to her. In parallel, Audric has a similar choice to make at a prom party.

title: Shame and Money
overview: After losing their livelihood in a village, a Kosovar family is forced to move to the capital in pursuit of a place in a hypercapitalist society.

title: Chronovisor
overview: A French academic is seduced into a world of untold histories in her scholarly quest to uncover the mystery of a history-capturing camera-like machine created by clandestine Benedictine monks. An academic-noir, armchair mystery in the lineage of Jorge Luis Borges and Umberto Eco.

title: The Man I Love
overview: In late 1980s New York, a theater artist living with AIDS takes on one possibly last great role.

title: Sugar Mommy
overview: When a non-committal sugar mommy takes in her three sugar babies, jealousy erupts as one of them becomes determined to be her one and only.

title: Jim Queen
overview: When Heterosis - a mysterious virus that turns gay men straight sweeps through the Parisian gay scene, Jim, the six packed sovereign of the Gym Queens, goes from Pride royalty to social outcast. With only Lucien, a freshly-out twink with more heart than abs, still by his side, Jim must race to find a cure before the disease erases the community that once worshipped him.

title: Never Change!
overview: In 2008, the graduating class of North Meadows High School had their senior year cut short due to a disastrous tornado. Now in their mid-30s, they're being forced to return home and finish high school once and for all.

title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
overview: Robin Byrd pioneered NYC public access with her cult sex-positive call-in show.  Now the larger-than-life 70-year-old champion of free speech, queer visibility, and safe sex reflects on her unique legacy and her hidden, decades-long marriage behind the scenes.

title: Headshot
overview: When two horribly unemployed recent grads discover on LinkedIn that their least favorite person on the planet is successful and (GOD FORBID) thriving, they try to replicate her perfect headshot to get hired.

title: Remember When...
overview: Two estranged friends, meeting for the first time in years, start to journey through their memories. As they travel along, strange details begin creeping up, forcing them to come to terms with a personal tragedy.

title: Death Boom
overview: As a “spiritual follow-up” to 'Fin', 'Death Boom' “pulls back the curtain on the catastrophic mental and environmental impacts of the contemporary death care industry. The film, shown through the lens of the workers at the heart of it as they prepare for the passing of 77 million baby boomers, exposes the toll that embalming, cremation, and traditional burial have on those who’ve passed, their families, and deathcare workers, and the corruption – political, religious, and corporate – that stands in opposition to greener methods being nationally legalized and accessible.”

title: Mexicanamerican
overview: Expertly merging old VHS home movies with new family interviews, filmmaker Eddie Sánchez traces his parents' journey from Mexico to the U.S. in this poignant and affecting documentary debut.

title: Flathead
overview: After a dish-pig invites his could-be-girlfriend over for dinner, his plans are shattered by the return of his charismatic fugitive brother.

title: Our Birthdays
overview: A seemingly ordinary Belgian family navigates the quiet weight of daily life, where silence speaks louder than words. As home videos and shared routines intertwine, subtle cracks in their world reveal a presence that refuses to fade, blurring the line between memory and reality in a tender reflection on love and lingering grief.

title: About
overview: Everyone wants to make a movie, but about what?

title: Heart of Light: Eleven Songs for Fiji
overview: After decades abroad, Iona returns to her childhood home on Fiji, sensing that there she might find the answers to many questions she has about civilisation and its discontent.

title: The Furious
overview: After a criminal network kidnaps Wang Wei's daughter and the corrupt police refuse to assist him, Wei sets out on his own to locate her. Navin, a tenacious journalist whose wife has mysteriously vanished, is his only ally. In this explosive martial arts showdown, the unlikely duo fights the kidnappers ruthlessly driven by a furious vengeance.

title: Colors of Evil: Black
overview: Investigating the disappearance of children in a remote Polish town, prosecutor Leopold Bilski must unravel a sinister local legend before it's too late.

title: Sing Geetham
overview: In an isolated village, young Prathap seeks opportunity but enters a world of deception. Drawn into uncontrollable forces, he's caught between progress and preservation, testing his beliefs and purpose.

title: The Prompt
overview: 'The Prompt' takes an everyday tool for some and twists it into a dystopian, inescapable nightmare...

title: Main Vaapas Aaunga
overview: Haunted by a childhood romance and recollections of love lost during the 1947 Partition of India, 95-year-old Ishar Singh Grewal shares his story with his grandson Nirvair, the past unfolding through memories of migration, longing, and a romance that endures across generations.

title: Chris & Martina: The Final Set
overview: Tennis legends Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova reflect on their parallel journeys to sports stardom while delving into their rivalry and friendship, especially as the duo continue to support each other through their shared experience of cancer treatment.

title: Vertiginous
overview: Jacques goes to his friend Bruno's house to tell him some big news: the entire human race is living in a simulation...

title: Three Hits
overview: Once classmates Petar, Strahinja, and Lazar reunite for their prom anniversary and are forced to face old wounds during one turbulent night.

title: Sanctus House
overview: Four college students venture to a storied haunted house over night. The goal is simple, obtain research for a paper they are writing on urban myths and legends. A caretaker, played by Richard Grieco, greets them and offers to share the tale of the home's tragic beginnings. As events unfold, the group starts to understand there's more to the stories.

title: Act One
overview: A young aspiring actress, desperate for guidance and belonging, falls under the spell of a manipulative acting coach who draws her into a web of control and obsession.

title: A Second Life
overview: July 26, 2024 — the day of the Olympic Games Opening Ceremony. Elisabeth, a hearing impaired young woman, is torn between depression and the pressure of managing short-term rentals in a hectic Paris. The arrival of Elijah, a radiant and carefree Californian, disrupts her fragile balance.

title: Adulto/Homem
overview: What can 20 actors’ faces, waiting for a casting call, reveal?

title: VENDETTA-THE BEAST WITHIN
overview: An assassin’s brutal past collides with fate, igniting relentless revenge.

title: The Union
overview: A small union gathers for a crucial meeting. As the evening drags on, it all descends into partying, drunkenness, and poor judgment. With the leadership out of the picture, new candidates are forced forward, and what should have been an orderly process evolves into an increasingly chaotic power struggle.

title: Christina Grimmie: Her Voice and Legacy A Decade Later
overview: The official 10th-anniversary film, Christina Grimmie: Her Voice and Legacy a Decade Later, traces her extraordinary journey from bedroom recordings that ignited a following of millions, to her landmark appearance on The Voice, through the tragedy of June 10, 2016, and beyond. Told through the voices of those who knew her best, including first-hand accounts from her father Bud, her brother Marcus, childhood friend Lauren Longo, and fellow artists who shared her world, the film refuses to let that night be the final word.

title: Peccatum
overview: Peccatum is a poetic coming-of-age story about two young women growing up in a secluded Christian community. When one of them loses her parents, she seeks comfort and salvation in pagan spirituality. Amid shared moments of intimacy and innocence, a bond begins to form between them—one that gradually comes into conflict with faith, guilt, and the fear of being discovered.  Inspired by the work of Sofia Coppola.

title: Decorruption
overview: Alex and Maya use Time Travel to stop Harold from winning the election and becoming a Dictator

title: Absolution
overview: A minister visits a grieving family in the midst of a missing mother, and finds evil lurking in their home.

title: Nobody's Son
overview: The script centres on Mathilda and Thomas, married for over 15 years. They’ve always dreamed of having children, but their efforts were only met with failures. After having adopted Mapring, a 4-year-old boy from Thailand, their life takes a tragic turn when Mathilda dies in an accident. Thomas then finds himself alone with a child he hadn’t really wanted. Devastated by this loss and incapable of forming a bond with Mapring, he decides to go look for the child’s biological family. Accompanied by Chaan, a local guide, Thomas starts on a trying journey through Thailand. Over time, father and son start to tame each other and create bonds… However, a crucial question remains: what will Thomas do when he finds Mapring’s biological family?

title: The Birthday Party
overview: Thomas, Nora and their teenage daughter Ida live on remote marshland. Social contact is limited, as they only have one neighbour, Cristina, an Italian painter. As the two households plan a surprise birthday party for Nora, strange disturbances begin to occur and unease rolls over the marsh.

title: Coward
overview: Pierre, a young Belgian soldier, wants to prove himself on the battlefield during the First World War. Behind the frontlines, he meets Francis, who is asked to find a way to boost morale.

title: Disclosure Day
overview: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.

title: Kijsada Paradise
overview: A friend who goes missing in an abandoned amusement park sets the friendship of a group of teenagers to a challenge as they encounter conflict and secrets along the way.

title: SYNTAX
overview: In a futuristic world like earth, androids act, feel and appear like humans. But when Azimov, the dictator of the last remaining city, Syntax, decides to use androids for power, the humans left on this world start to view androids no longer as their equals. In a revolt, the androids aim to escape. Revyn and Ava almost break out until Ava is captured and Revyn is shot. When a scavenger reawakens Revyn in a scrapyard, he must journey far and wide, fight wasteland nomads and maintain what is left of his humanity, in hope of finding Ava.

title: Cosmic Strangers
overview: Cosmic Strangers is a love story between two people, Oli and Ben, where we follow their blooming friendship from kids to teens, the exploration of their identities, the all-consuming romance that follows, and the challenges they face as an adult queer couple.

title: The Crew
overview: After retiring from the business, ex thief Johnny Valentine, runs into an old acquaintance and decides to throw away his comfortable life for one last job.

title: Le tueur de la mort qui tue sa mère II
Thirdwheel
overview: Jess and Joey have grown up beside each other, from family problems to teenage drama- they have always been there for one another.  When a new boy enters their world, it disrupts their comfortable pattern. A once safe place for both girls turns into a jealous ridden and unstable relationship.  As each girl is tested- will they be able to trust themselves and live authentically.

title: 'Witch Hunt'
overview: A reclusive herbalist living in the woods is approached by a desperate townsman with ulterior motives.

title: The History of Concrete
overview: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.

title: Congo Boy
overview: Bangui, Central African Republic. 17 year-old Robert dreams of a career in music, but civil war is tearing the country apart. When both his parents are thrown into prison, he is left to look after his four younger siblings on his own, juggling daily life, odd jobs, school exams and concert stages, determined to follow his dream.

title: Ben'Imana
overview: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.

title: Kikirot Kirot
overview: A married couple’s life unravels when the wife’s cousin moves in. The husband realizes she’s the stripper he secretly met before, sparking temptation, deception, and fear of exposure.

title: Maternal Instinct
overview: Police pull over a woman who claims she just gave birth. But the baby — and the blood — aren't hers. Twisted lies unravel in this true-crime documentary.

title: In the Hand of Dante
overview: A Vatican priest discovers Dante's original Divine Comedy manuscript. When asked to authenticate it, writer Nick Tosches steals it, while a parallel story follows Dante's quest to create his masterpiece.

title: Fatherland
overview: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

title: A Family of Bastards
overview: After the death of his father, Mohamed discovers the living of a step-brother and a step-sister. Together, they must manage the suspicious bar they inherited of linked to criminality, drug traffic and prostitution.

title: Badland Rising
overview: An ordinary bloke embarks on a 19-hour drive home, unaware of being pursued by two unhinged criminals. Once he discovers their motive, his journey turns into a brutal fight for survival.

title: Haunted 3D: Echoes of the Past
overview: A man seeks refuge in a remote Indian mountain mansion, fleeing his past. He discovers the house harbors sinister secrets, pain, and terror ready to torment him.

title: Governor
overview: Set against Indias 1990 economic crisis, Governor follows Raman, a reluctant bureaucrat unexpectedly appointed as the Governor of the RBI when the nation stands on the brink of bankruptcy. As inflation rises, fuel runs low, and panic spreads, Raman must navigate political pressure and a collapsing system to prevent the country from falling apart.

title: Still Sexy
overview: Maddalena has it all: a job she loves, the perfect fiancé, and a dream wedding ahead. Yet in the bedroom, something feels wrong. Urged on by her inner voice, embodied by pornstar Valentina Nappi, she begins to question her life. Meeting Bruno, a gardener with a troubled past, leads her to rediscover herself and realize the only path worth following is her own.

title: My Lover
overview: After choosing love over privilege, Yuan Xinyi and Liang Jingtian begin a life together without the support of her family. But as financial pressures mount and reality sets in, their once-unshakable romance is put to the ultimate test.

title: Roberto Zucco
overview: One night, Roberto Zucco escapes from the prison where he was incarcerated for the murder of his father. Thus begins a dizzying escape, punctuated by encounters that illustrate a quest for identity.

title: Vitiated
overview: Alone in the woods, Olive runs into Ava. After saving her life, they grow a close bond and take on the zombie apocalypse together.

title: Chalien Kahin
overview: Two parallel life. living in same city, going through Same problems and have Same desire - To go back HOME.

title: All of a Sudden
overview: Marie-Lou Fontaine, director of a nursing home in the Paris suburbs, defies convention by adopting the 'Humanitude' method despite her team’s resistance. Her encounter with Mari Morisaki, a terminally ill Japanese playwright, transforms her life. Together, they turn the facility into a symbol of resistance and humanity against the system’s limits.

title: Mancave
overview: Charlotte Husebø is drawn into a labyrinth of repressed fantasies and dark secrets when she discovers that her husband, Didrik Husebø, has a hidden room in the family's garage.

title: This Tempting Madness
overview: A young woman awakens from a coma grievously injured, memory fractured, her husband arrested. But as she puts together the pieces of her past, she starts to question her own actions — and her perception of reality.

title: Bubbe & Tal
overview: A stoner buddy-dramedy between a Jewish grandmother and her trans grandchild on a day trip to Cape Cod during the off-season.

title: Toy Story: 30 Years and Beyond - A Special Edition of 20/20
overview: Exploring the 40-year legacy of Pixar through the lens of its innovative and wildly successful franchise "Toy Story"; Pixar Animation Studios in Emeryville, Calif.; interviews with original cast members.

title: Beyond Files
overview: Case files document encounters with alien forces and altered realities, uncovering a pattern beyond human understanding.

title: Missing Pieces
overview: This story follows our protagonist Henry's battle with grief and depression. Trying to use faith and forgiveness to move on with his life.

title: Double Occupancy
overview: Rajini transforms between woman by day and man by night, hiding this gender swap from partners creating tangled complications.

title: La Bola Negra
overview: Set across three timelines — Republican Spain in 1932, the Civil War in 1937, and contemporary Spain in 2017 — the film follows a constellation of interconnected lives centered on three young men, whose emotional and political echoes gradually reveal themselves.

title: Minotaur
overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

title: Groundskeeper
overview: It was supposed to be a fun weekend. A trip away for a close-knit friend group to celebrate the end of high school. But when their estranged former best friend shows up, unannounced, with her douche boyfriend in tow… plans change. Tensions rise, friendships are tested, and the whole weekend seems hopeless. As a last-ditch attempt to save the trip, the group revisits a game from their childhood, a game inspired by a local ghost story. What started out as a fun activity turns deadly as real life begins to mirror the actions of the game, leading the friends to question each other and their own judgement. After all, no one really believes in ghosts… right?

title: See Me
overview: When his father refuses to stop reaching out, a young man groomed online at twelve must decide whether to finally let someone see what was left behind.

title: Fjord
overview: After the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave everything behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth offers the promise of a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghius' young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

title: The Commandments
overview: Two young homeless people are invited to live in a house. But it seems to have a strange, unique set of rules.

title: Meat Finders
overview: 3 People that find meat are all enthused in getting some. They call for help, then a local experienced resident comes out. He helps them with the traps and they hide. He made a clear rule... don't look at the meat when it comes.

title: Manila Sunset
overview: When a sudden family death pulls a fractured Filipino-American family back under one roof, a week of funeral preparations becomes a final chance to reunite as their Lola (grandmother) slowly forgets them all.

title: Mr Adidos
overview: In search of a perfect vintage sweater, a lonely artist is drawn into the chaotic orbit of two thrift-shopping twins, leading brand-label-status, shame and longing to collide in an unexpectedly tender and surreal encounter.

title: The Dreamed Adventure
overview: The story of a woman living in the border region between Bulgaria, Greece and Turkey, who agrees to partake in a special deal in order to help a friend. However, this will lead her into a dangerous situation, and she will have to confront her desires

title: Lomu
overview: A Tongan/Kiwi warrior who could run 100 metres in under 11 seconds. He was the youngest All Black to put on the jersey and still holds the record for the most tries scored in World Cup history.

title: Red Rocks
overview: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.

title: Tangles
overview: When Alzheimer's disease begins to strip away her mother's vibrant personality, a headstrong young woman is forced to return to her oddball family in the conservative small town she recently fled in order to care for her. She quickly realizes she must accept the cruel and warped reality of the disease, and the imperfect beauty of her family, in order to become the daughter they need.

title: Inevitably Alone
overview: When a grieving father is diagnosed with terminal cancer, his desperate attempts to reconnect with his estranged sons force them all to confront the weight of loss, love, and the inevitability of being left behind.

title: Quantum Entangled
overview: When two strangers find themselves connected in bizarre and unusual ways, they learn their souls are entangled at the quantum level.

title: Shin Neko
overview: The film follows Mako, a young boy who's given the responsibility of looking after her granny's cat: Yuki. However, panic sets in when the cat suddenly goes missing. Fearing he will be blamed for the mistake, the boy embarks on a frantic search around the neighborhood, desperate to find Yuki before his dad returns.

title: 16 Pages
overview: A not so good in his mind director tries to get funding for his new film

title: Sisyphus
overview: 1 Godfather, 2 Goons, 3 Euros and a whole lot of Greek Cult TV

title: NJPW Dominion 6.14 In Osaka-Jo Hall
overview: Dominion 6.14 In Osaka-Jo Hall was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on June 14, 2026, at Osaka-jō Hall in Osaka, Japan. The show was headlined by an IWGP Heavyweight Championship match between reigning champion Callum Newman and Yota Tsuji, who earned a title shot after pinning Newman in a tag team match at New Japan Road in Karatsu 2026 ~ Ignition to Dominion in May 2026.

title: Super Nature
overview: We’re invited on a journey across 25 different countries, with people embracing both abundance and loss, to feel a sense of togetherness with our fellow dwellers on earth, human and non-human. Celebrating all we have and reflecting on all we have to lose, Super Nature proposes a new way of seeing.

title: Paper Tiger
overview: Two brothers chase the American dream, but soon find themselves in the brutal world of violence and corruption of the Russian mafia.

title: Ramli's Photocopy
overview: At a small photocopy shop, Ramli spends his days reading fragments of other people's lives through the documents they leave behind. When a former high school acquaintance he once adored unexpectedly reappears, their growing friendship stirs old dreams, buried disappointments, and quiet questions about identity, failure, and the lives we choose to present to others.

title: Remember Death
overview: After a terminal diagnosis, Charlie realises that her time is near, leaving her with only a few weeks left to live. But she soon realises that death isn't unseen like she thinks.

title: My Name Is Rafaela
overview: Rafaela, a 19-year-old transgender girl, finds herself torn between two identities: Rafaela, the woman she sees herself as, and Daniel, the man those around her perceive her as. While navigating her college life and engaging with friends and a romantic interest, this dissonance generates increasing internal confusion, leading her to question who she truly is and how she wants to be percieved.

title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
overview: Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah accepts her grandma's outrageous challenge: 40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of rent. From awkward dinners to unexpected sparks, she discovers the biggest obstacle to love might just be herself.

title: Bride Beyond
overview: It follows a forensic doctor and a security commander investigating a ghost story linked to an old debt and a mysterious wedding.

title: Dead Air
overview: On the anniversary of her renowned musician sister's death, a young radio presenter revisits her unreleased demo tapes in the studio for a documentary and finds herself haunted by the guilt of her past sins. Based on 'The Raven' and 'The Tell-tale Heart' by Edgar Allan Poe.

title: RedLine
overview: "Ajoy" a mechanic who has a high ego and prestige wants to get more money for fame and success, along with his friend "Biluy" who is also a mechanic. "Ajoy" began to plan and invite "biluy" to join him in illegal racing at night. On the other hand, the car they used in the illegal race was their customer's car which made the situation and atmosphere that night began to worry "Biluy". Until when they finished the race everything felt in vain, to the point where they had to run from the car owner's pursuit.

title: The River's Bend
overview: Among images of a utopian everyday life, the Paranaíba river tries to understand why Anair is so afraid of its depths.

title: Your Fault: London
overview: Nick and Noah are both embarking on life-changing adventures that are threatening to pull them apart—Nick in business with his father and Noah starting a fresh chapter at Oxford University. Now living separate lives, and meeting new people, they find themselves entangled in temptations, rivalries, and betrayals and their bond is tested like never before. As secrets unravel and temptation rises, they must fight to hold onto each other—or risk losing everything.

title: 40 Wacks
overview: When a group of friends wander into a long abandoned home they soon discover that a evil spirit is among them.

title: Checkout: The Movie
overview: The supermarket workers leave the sleepy supermarket in Yavneh for a crazy adventure in which they are accused of a serious crime in a plot that begins in a detention cell and countinues with an escape story of Shefa Isasschar in an attempt to save their good name.

title: MALWARE
overview: Led by a cybernetic soldier a group of exterminators in a fading zombie apocalypse have been sent to clear out an old infected zone long believed to be empty ... Or is it ?

title: Best Friends
overview: Robert doesn’t wake, dress, or even shave without the help of his best friends, Ewa and Adam. He has outsourced his whole existence, delegating every practical and emotional detail of his life. As the day of a career-defining interview unfolds, subtle cracks begin to appear. Faced with a situation that demands independence, Robert starts to question not only his own abilities, but also how much of himself he has already surrendered.

title: No Hard Feelings
overview: Down-on-his-luck ride-hailing driver Li Song eases his frustrations via an obscure podcast, held back from new romance by an embarrassing chronic ailment. Yin, pretending to be a Korean customer service agent at a health-supplement firm, drudges through client calls to save for an apartment. A follow-up phone call draws these two lonely urban strangers together behind lies. As reality and delusion crumble, they are forced to confront life and their true selves.

title: Extreme Makeover: Homer Edition
overview: Homer and Marge's fun couples' date night goes off the rails when Marge learns Homer left the kids unsupervised with only the doorbell camera as a babysitter. Frustrated with her imperfect husband, a tipsy Marge stirs up a trilogy of fantasies of a different Homer.

title: The Stories
overview: The Stories is a decades-spanning Egyptian family saga and love story set between the late 1960s and 1980s. The film follows Ahmed, a young man from a Middle-Class Cairo family who dreams of becoming a concert pianist. During the tense summer of 1967, as war looms over Egypt, he begins a pen-pal correspondence with an Austrian woman named Elizabeth (“Liz”). A semi-autobiographical film based on the director's parents and how they met.

title: Home Along da Riles: Da Reunion
overview: Years after Kevin Cosme's death, his children strive to uphold the values he taught them. Tensions arise when Bing announces her plan to marry her mysterious long-time boyfriend, prompting her brothers Bill, Bob, Baldo, and Estong to attempt to stop the wedding. Meanwhile, Azon, Kevin's widow, becomes saddened by the children's growing disunity and apparent abandonment of the values they were raised with, while imagining visions of Kevin as if he were still alive.

title: Soar
overview: Hyun-jae, a 16-year-old escaping her abusive father, manipulates Hae-in, a woman searching for her missing daughter, into taking her in as a replacement. Over the summer, Hyun-jae bonds with Hae-in, finding peace through her love for singing, but becomes obsessed with becoming Hae-in's new daughter. When Hae-in learns her missing daughter may have been found, Hyun-jae, despite her fears, makes a selfless decision to accompany her, realizing she can't replace Yun-seul.

title: Toy Story 5
overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

title: The Get Out
overview: A nightclub owner is on the verge of leaving his dangerous past behind for retirement with his girlfriend. When masked gunmen rob him and he finds himself squeezed by ruthless cartels, a mysterious newcomer arrives with an interest in buying the business. With danger closing in from all sides, he must navigate a deadly web of deception, power, and survival  -  where escape may no longer be an option.

title: The Death of Robin Hood
overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

title: Girls Like Girls
overview: Coley, 17, from rural Oregon, navigates intimacy after her mother's passing. Meeting Sonya sparks new feelings, but self-doubt hinders their connection. Sonya, unfamiliar with dating girls, is uncertain. They learn to embrace emotions.

title: Maa Inti Bangaram
overview: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.

title: Leviticus
overview: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most — each other.

title: Strung
overview: A talented violinist's prestigious new role as a music tutor for an enigmatic, elite family spirals into a psychological battle for her safety and sanity.

title: Cerita Lila
overview: Two twins named Lila and Lili. Both experienced tragic ends after alleged abuse by their own mother, Rahma. However, death does not immediately end their story. In another realm, Lila continues to search for her twin sister, Lili, who was separated from her. This search then leads Lila into a greater mystery that has been hidden. In addition to facing a deep sense of loss, Lila also tries to understand the reasons behind the tragedy that destroyed their lives. Meanwhile, mysterious figures begin to appear and reveal that there is a greater power deliberately hiding the truth.

title: Unraveled
overview: Maria is a former elite swimmer and famous sports commentator whose life unravels when her beloved husband Mikael, her former coach and father of their daughter, is suddenly suspected of sexual abuse. Sparking the scandal and media interest is the revelation in an upcoming book, of a young girl’s misguided infatuation for her swimming coach, with rumors suggesting that Mikael is the man in question.

title: Les Dreamables
overview: A film about a guy struggling with Les Dreamables.

title: Робоняня

Confident that she can easily trick the car, Zlata soon discovers that she is dealing with an invulnerable opponent who controls the entire house. Desperate, she and her neighbor Nikita, who is in love with her, find an unconventional way out - they begin to communicate with the robot in its language, using "perfect promts". Their friendship with their iron friend is rapidly gaining momentum and leads to a huge party, which turns into real chaos. It is at this moment that Zlata has to make a choice and understand what true friendship and self-sacrifice are.

title: Silent Flood
overview: Set by a beautiful river canyon in Western Ukraine, a pacifist community with unique religious beliefs, sees their peaceful way of life gradually distressed by regular floods and eventually an unexpected war.

title: Slackers

But instead of thinking about their future, they prefer to let the hot Berlin summer get the better of them. When they release a beloved neighbor's bird, they have to flee - into the politically charged world that they really don't want to be in. A road trip through Berlin begins - but on foot.

title: Atlantic Rhapsody
overview: Ding Mao, a supermarket employee, accidentally cooks the ornamental shark kept in the store. Soon after, he starts hearing a strange voice. Travelling from a southern city to the wilds of Northeast China, he sets out to trace his father’s whereabouts. During this journey, he pieces together his father’s bizarre life through an abandoned amusement park, a zoo in winter, and the supermarket where shark meat is sold. A quirky experimental musician, a blind fortune-teller who can understand animal language, a trainer whose legs were bitten off by a shark, and a female picture book painter — guided by the mysterious voice, all these souls become intertwined.

title: Meet Me in the Margins

title: Maiin Haan

He then spends his whole life carrying out a nearly four-decade pursuit without regrets.
